text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًۭا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًۭا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector carrying the prior denial scene into this ayah
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ayah syntactically attached to the preceding scene before the impossible sign-demand begins. The reader hears the counterfactual as a continuation of the unresolved denial scene, not as an isolated maxim, and the connector also widens the register from messenger-speech in 13:30 into divine adjudication.

topics.headline: continuation into the counterfactual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins from an already active denial scene rather than opening a detached hypothetical.
topics.reason: The row evidence treats the initial connector as a continuation and register bridge from 13:30 into 13:31.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle opening an unreal conditional with an elided answer
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) opens the unreal conditional that gathers the three impossible sign scenarios under one frame. Because the answer is left unstated and later displaced by the corrective turn, the miracle demand is exposed as a mismeasured premise rather than a live path to faith.

topics.headline: unreal sign-demand frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse is not promising those wonders; it stages them as an unreal test case whose expected answer is withheld.
topics.reason: Grammar and structural rows identify the particle as a counterfactual frame with a suppressed apodosis answered by the later corrective particle.

words.gloss_range: subordinating assertive particle governing the following accusative noun
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) folds the following recitation-word into the content of the counterfactual. The impossible operations are therefore predicated of a specific imagined recited object inside the law-frame, not introduced as an independent topic.

topics.headline: content folded under the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recitation object belongs inside the hypothetical proposition before the corrective turn arrives.
topics.reason: QAC and structural rows mark the particle as governing the following accusative phrase inside the counterfactual clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative recitation in a class-testing hypothetical, not merely a proper-title surface
words.root_gloss_range: reciting, collecting, and gathered utterance; locally narrowed to an imagined recitation made the instrument of impossible signs
words.prose: {{ar:قُرْءَانًۭا}} ({{tr:qurʾānan}}) is indefinite and accusative inside the counterfactual, so the wording tests the idea of a recitation of such a kind rather than simply naming scripture as a title. The root’s collecting and reciting pressure survives as gathered utterance, while the local frame makes one recited object govern three passive sign scenarios and recalls mountain-revelation pressure (59:21).

topics.headline: indefinite recitation as imagined instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one imagined recitation carrying three cosmic demands, so the issue is not lack of sign-power but misplaced control of signs.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows combine indefinite grammar, q-r-ʾ root pressure, triple passive governance, and the mountain-revelation echo; the local grammar narrows these to the hypothetical recitation role.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect presenting mountain movement as an accomplished hypothetical result
words.root_gloss_range: travel, going, and being set in motion; locally narrowed to caused motion of mountains in an unreal passive frame
words.prose: {{ar:سُيِّرَتْ}} ({{tr:suyyirat}}) presents the mountains as made to move in an accomplished passive scene, with the feminine singular verb treating the non-human plural as a collective created mass. The travel-root image turns fixed creation into forced journey, with a secondary human-journey resonance, while Form II and the passive keep agency unnamed and subordinate the event to the unreal condition; the eschatological mountain-moving echo remains contrastive (81:3).

topics.headline: mountains made to travel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fixed mountains are imagined as forced into motion, but only inside the counterfactual sign-demand.
topics.reason: Grammar, form, root, and echo rows support caused passive movement while the counterfactual frame prevents treating the event as locally promised.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition marking the means for the first passive action; pronoun-fusion claims are limited by the aligned bare surface
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks instrumentality for the first impossible operation. Some row language treats the sequence as a repeated bihi chain, but the aligned local surface here is the bare preposition, so the surviving payoff is the start of a means-pattern rather than a full preposition-pronoun form at this token.

topics.headline: instrumental preposition begins the means-chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first sign as grammatically tied to a means, while the pronoun-bearing repetition is reserved for the later bihi tokens.
topics.reason: QAC aligns this word as a bare preposition, so rows about fused bihi are narrowed to the broader instrumental sequence.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative mountain-plural receiving passive movement
words.root_gloss_range: mountain, molded solidity, and fixed created nature; locally narrowed to the concrete mountain class under passive motion
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالُ}} ({{tr:al-jibālu}}) names the mountains as the passive recipients of the first imagined wonder. The root pressure of molded solidity makes their movement a reversal of created fixity, and the image belongs to a wider Quranic mountain motif of stability and displacement (78:7; 59:21).

topics.headline: created solidity reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first miracle targets the emblem of created stability, making the sign-demand cosmic in scale.
topics.reason: Rows support passive-subject grammar, mountain solidity, and intertextual mountain pressure, while local grammar keeps the sense on concrete mountains.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive particle separating alternatives inside the same counterfactual
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) introduces the next sign-mode without leaving the original counterfactual frame. The alternatives are presented as a menu of impossible proofs, not as a cumulative sequence that must all occur.

topics.headline: first alternative in one test case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each proposed wonder is an alternative demand under one unreal premise.
topics.reason: Grammar and semantic rows identify the particle as disjunctive within the same hypothetical sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect for intensive cutting of the earth in the unreal sequence
words.root_gloss_range: severing, cutting through, and traversing; locally narrowed to intensive segmentation of the earth under the counterfactual
words.prose: {{ar:قُطِّعَتْ}} ({{tr:quṭṭiʿat}}) parallels the mountain verb with an accomplished passive, but now the imagined act is intensive segmentation of the earth. The root’s severing and traversing range gives the image a total breach of continuity, while the same-surah moral cutting echo remains a thematic contrast (13:25).

topics.headline: earth violently segmented
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second wonder as rupture of the whole terrestrial field, not a small local cut.
topics.reason: Rows support passive perfect grammar, Form II intensity, root severing/traversing pressure, and same-surah cutting echoes, narrowed to the local earth-cutting frame.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus pronoun referring back to the recitation
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) repeats the instrument phrase and points the earth-cutting back to the same imagined recitation. The repetition aligns the second wonder with the first instead of allowing it to become an independent miracle source.

topics.headline: same instrument repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second impossible act still depends on the same recited instrument.
topics.reason: QAC and structural rows align this token as the second instrumental pronoun phrase in the sequence.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative earth-word receiving passive cutting
words.root_gloss_range: earth as ground, territory, and inhabited substrate; locally narrowed to the terrestrial field acted upon by cutting
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضُ}} ({{tr:al-arḍu}}) is the passive recipient of the cutting, extending the sequence from mountains to the whole terrestrial substrate. Its earth range can include ground and inhabited territory, so the image threatens geography and the human world built on it, with same-surah earth language in the background (13:25).

topics.headline: whole earth as acted-on body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the escalation from vertical mountain fixtures to the wider inhabited earth.
topics.reason: Rows support passive-subject grammar, earth-as-ground/territory semantics, and same-surah echoes; the local role narrows them to the cut earth image.

words.gloss_range: second disjunctive particle introducing the climactic alternative
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) pivots the sequence from terrain to the dead while keeping the same counterfactual frame. The third alternative is not a result of the earth-cutting clause; it is another proof-demand in the same unreal series.

topics.headline: pivot to the third wonder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the escalation from cosmic matter to the boundary of death.
topics.reason: Grammar and structure rows identify this particle as the second disjunction in the three-part sign sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect foregrounding the event of being spoken to
words.root_gloss_range: speech, words, and wounding contact; locally narrowed to intensive address in the passive miracle frame
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّمَ}} ({{tr:kullima}}) suppresses the speaker and foregrounds the impossible event of address, with a compact singular passive placed before the plural dead are named. The speech-root's contact and wounding pressure survives as verbal piercing of the death-boundary, while the passive keeps the miracle inside the same unreal sign-demand rather than turning it into an actual resurrection scene.

topics.headline: dead addressed by passive speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the climactic wonder is communicative contact with the dead, not merely another physical alteration.
topics.reason: Rows support passive perfect grammar, Form II speech intensity, root speech/contact range, and the place of this verb as the third passive miracle.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus pronoun referring again to the recitation
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) repeats the same instrument reference for the third time. By the time the dead are addressed, the wording has made all three wonders depend on one imagined recited instrument.

topics.headline: third instrument phrase seals the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the three miracles are held together by a repeated instrument phrase rather than by three separate agencies.
topics.reason: Rows identify the third bihi token as completing the repeated instrumental chain.

words.gloss_range: definite plural dead receiving the passive address
words.root_gloss_range: death, deadness, and lifelessness across persons, hearts, and land; locally narrowed to the dead as collective recipients of impossible speech
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-mawtā}}) names the dead as the recipients of the passive speech, and its collective force makes the wonder address the dead as a class rather than one corpse. The death-root can resonate with physical death, spiritual lifelessness, and dead land, but the local grammar keeps them as those addressed, not as agents or as proof that the sign demand would produce faith.

topics.headline: the dead as speech recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the climax: the demanded sign reaches beyond terrain into the human boundary of death.
topics.reason: Rows support plural deadness, passive-recipient grammar, and the escalation from mountains and earth to mortality.

words.gloss_range: adversative corrective particle redirecting from sign-demand to divine command
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) breaks the hypothetical sequence and redirects the ayah to divine ownership of the command. The particle does not merely continue the sentence; it cancels the miracle-demand premise and supplies the real answer after the elided counterfactual result. At the ayah scale, it is the hinge from counterfactual signs into the corrective command movement before believer realization, denier consequence, and promise guarantee.

topics.headline: corrective cancellation of the premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse refusing to let spectacular signs become the center of authority.
topics.reason: Rows describe the particle as corrective/adversative, linked to the elided apodosis and the shift to the divine command.

words.gloss_range: preposition of possession or attribution fronted before the command noun
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) begins the fronted attribution that places the command with God. Its position helps make the corrective clause about possession and authority before the command itself is named, and the fronting gives the phrase restrictive force: the command is God's alone, not the deniers' or the miracle-demanders'.

topics.headline: exclusive attribution begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authority is grammatically assigned before the noun for command appears.
topics.reason: Rows identify the preposition as lām of possession or attribution in the fronted predicate phrase.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name governed by the attribution preposition
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with deity-reference and etymological caution in the background; locally the named possessor/source of command
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is the genitive proper divine name in the fronted possession phrase, so the command is attributed to God before it is named. The lexical evidence keeps etymological caution in the background and distinguishes the proper name from common deity language; the same-surah command and worship field reinforces that the corrective answer rests in divine authority, not in an impersonal mechanism.

topics.headline: divine possessor of the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to miracle-demand is personal divine authority.
topics.reason: Rows support the genitive role after the lām phrase and connect the divine name with command and same-surah authority language.

words.gloss_range: definite command/matter noun as delayed subject of the fronted divine attribution
words.root_gloss_range: command, affair, matter, and decree; locally narrowed to comprehensive divine command after the corrective turn
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمْرُ}} ({{tr:al-amru}}) names the thing that belongs to God: the command, affair, or decisive matter. The root range includes command and decree, but the local fronted phrase and following totality make the point comprehensive: sign outcomes, guidance, and judgment are not available for human control.

topics.headline: the whole command belongs to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse answers spectacle-demand with command-sovereignty, not with another spectacle.
topics.reason: Rows support delayed-subject grammar, ʾ-m-r command/decree semantics, and same-surah command-field echoes; local syntax narrows the force to divine ownership of the whole affair.

words.gloss_range: accusative totality term functioning as circumstantial or emphatic totalizer
words.root_gloss_range: gathering and total inclusion; locally used to make the divine command comprehensive
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) totalizes the preceding command claim. The word makes the ownership of the affair complete rather than partial, so no portion of sign-control, guidance, or consequence is carved out for rivals. Its form also sets up the ayah's paired totality axis with the later all-people guidance clause.

topics.headline: totalizing the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not just generally divine; it is gathered wholly under God.
topics.reason: Rows support the accusative totalizer function and its connection to the ayah’s comprehensive divine authority.

words.gloss_range: interrogative particle opening a rebuking or awakening question
words.prose: {{ar:أَ}} ({{tr:a}}) turns from the corrective command statement into a question aimed at what believers should recognize. As the interrogative onset of the following negated question, it gives the turn a rebuking and instructive force, moving the ayah from impossible signs to the perception required of those who have faith.

topics.headline: question turn toward believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from exposing the demand to questioning whether believers have grasped its implication.
topics.reason: Rows identify the hamza as interrogative and structurally tied to the following negative-jussive clause.

words.gloss_range: negating jussive particle governing the following verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) negates the following verb and puts the question into a completed-recognition frame. The believers are not being invited to new spectacle, but pressed to see what should already be settled.

topics.headline: negative jussive opens recognition clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question rebukes a failure of recognition rather than asks for new evidence.
topics.reason: Rows support the jussive negation and its role in the believer-directed question.

words.gloss_range: jussive verb whose sense is locally recognition of impossibility, with despair/knowing pressure kept cautious
words.root_gloss_range: despair, giving up hope, and recognizing impossibility; locally narrowed to believers realizing sign-demand cannot compel guidance
words.prose: {{ar:يَا۟يْـَٔسِ}} ({{tr:yayʾasi}}) is locally more than emotional despair: in this construction it presses believers to recognize that if God had willed, guidance would already have encompassed all people. The despair branch survives as giving up the false hope that demanded signs can force faith, while the question-form keeps it as admonitory recognition.

topics.headline: despair as settled recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believers are asked to abandon confidence in spectacular proofs as the route to universal guidance.
topics.reason: Rows support the y-ʾ-s semantic range, jussive grammar after lam, and interpretive pressure toward recognition rather than ordinary hopelessness alone.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing the believing group as subject of the question
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) identifies the questioned group through a relative description. The wording does not speak abstractly about anyone; it turns the recognition-demand toward those characterized by faith.

topics.headline: believers named by relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the admonition is addressed to believers as believers.
topics.reason: The row evidence marks this relative pronoun as the subject phrase introducing the following faith description.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect naming those who have believed or trusted
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, faith, and becoming safe; locally narrowed to the community whose expectations about guidance are corrected
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) names the group as those who have believed, with the perfect plural presenting faith as an already assumed identity. The root's security and trust range remains relevant, but the local payoff is that faith must learn to rest in divine will, not in a theory that stronger signs would compel everyone; this believing group also stands opposite the deniers who remain under calamity later in the ayah.

topics.headline: faith group under correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even believers can need correction about how guidance works.
topics.reason: Rows support the Form IV faith verb, the trust/security root field, and the contrast with denial and guidance later in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive/content particle introducing what believers should recognize
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) introduces the content that the believers are being pressed to grasp. It turns the question from a bare rebuke into a specific doctrinal claim about divine will and universal guidance.

topics.headline: content clause after recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question has a precise content: the scope of guidance depends on God’s will.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as introducing the content clause after the recognition/despair verb.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle introducing the inner divine-will condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) opens the second counterfactual, now not about demanded signs but about God's will. The ayah moves from an unreal human premise to a theological counterfactual: if God had willed, guidance would have taken another scope. The following imperfect after this particle keeps the divine willing open rather than confining it to a past episode.

topics.headline: second counterfactual under divine will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between human sign-hypothetical and divine-will hypothetical.
topics.reason: Rows support the second law as a counterfactual inside the content clause, structurally answering the opening law-frame.

words.gloss_range: imperfect verb of willing in the inner counterfactual condition
words.root_gloss_range: willing, determining, and bringing a thing under volition; locally narrowed to God’s will regarding universal guidance
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) places the decisive condition in divine willing, with the object of willing left implicit and recoverable from the guidance result. The imperfect form after the counterfactual keeps that willing open as governing condition, not as a fulfilled universalizing decree. The root's thing/will range does not make all possible branches active here; it supports the local point that guidance for all people would occur only under God's volition.

topics.headline: divine willing governs scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is not constrained by sign capacity but by divine will.
topics.reason: Rows support the divine subject, will semantics, and structural role of this verb as the condition for universal guidance.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as subject of the willing verb
words.root_gloss_range: divine name and deity-reference; locally the explicit subject of willing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) explicitly names God as the subject of the will-condition. The clause therefore grounds universal guidance in God’s agency rather than in the imagined power of signs.

topics.headline: God as subject of willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition for universal guidance is attached to God personally.
topics.reason: Rows support nominative subject grammar and the discourse shift from sign mechanics to divine agency.

words.gloss_range: lām marking the result clause of the counterfactual
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) introduces the result of the divine-will counterfactual. It signals that the following guidance of all people is the emphatic apodosis of God's willing, so guidance would certainly follow under that condition rather than appearing as a separate assertion about what is currently happening.

topics.headline: apodosis marker before guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the guidance clause as the result of an unreal condition.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as the lām of apodosis after law.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb of guiding in the counterfactual result clause
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, directing, and bringing to a path, with concrete offering/directed-movement resonance in the background; locally narrowed to God guiding all people under the unreal will-condition
words.prose: {{ar:هَدَى}} ({{tr:hadā}}) states the unreal result: God would certainly have guided all people, as a completed hypothetical outcome under divine willing. The guidance-root range is broad, and the concrete offering or directed-movement resonance remains secondary, but here the grammar selects divine guidance as the counterfactual outcome, making the point that universal guidance is possible by will, not produced by spectacle-demand.

topics.headline: guidance could have encompassed all
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the issue is not God’s inability to guide but the fact that universal guidance has not been willed in that way.
topics.reason: Rows support perfect result grammar, h-d-y guidance semantics, the object phrase, and the theological contrast with sign demands.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative people as object of guidance
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability, peoplehood, and a traditional forgetfulness association; locally narrowed to all people as the direct object of guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nāsa}}) is the direct object of the counterfactual guidance verb. The word gathers the human field of the claim: not a tribe or faction, but people as a whole under the question of universal guidance. The etymological tension around human sociability and forgetfulness stays as a cautionary layer, while the local grammar selects the collective human object.

topics.headline: humanity as the guidance object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual scope is humanity-wide rather than limited to the disputants.
topics.reason: Rows support accusative object grammar, peoplehood semantics, and the universalizing context.

words.gloss_range: accusative totality term extending the guidance object to all people
words.root_gloss_range: gathering and total inclusion; locally marks comprehensive human scope
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًۭا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) completes the counterfactual by making the human object total. The word echoes the earlier totality of God’s command, so the ayah balances all command belonging to God with all people being guidable if God wills.

topics.headline: universal scope repeated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paired totalities: all command belongs to God, and all people could be guided by God’s will.
topics.reason: Rows support the totalizer grammar and the same-root echo with the earlier comprehensive command statement.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector shifting from theological counterfactual to continuing calamity
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the ayah from the believer-directed recognition clause to the ongoing condition of deniers. The connector carries the theological point into lived consequence rather than closing the verse at abstraction, moving from unreal universal guidance to actual ongoing consequence and widening the scene toward communal and eschatological scope.

topics.headline: transition to ongoing consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument moves from doctrine about guidance into historical pressure on deniers.
topics.reason: Rows identify this connector as the transition into the ongoing consequence clause.

words.gloss_range: negation particle forming a does-not-cease construction with the following verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) pairs with the following verb to form ongoing non-cessation. It marks the calamity sequence as continuing, not as a single completed punishment scene.

topics.headline: non-cessation begins with negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers’ consequence is recurring or ongoing.
topics.reason: Rows support the negation’s role with the auxiliary verb to create a non-cessation construction.

words.gloss_range: imperfect auxiliary in a non-cessation construction
words.root_gloss_range: ceasing, passing away, removal, displacement, and transit imagery; locally narrowed to an auxiliary expressing continued occurrence
words.prose: {{ar:يَزَالُ}} ({{tr:yazālu}}) with the preceding negation makes the punishment pressure ongoing. The z-w-l root's removal, passing-away, and transit imagery stays in the background, but the local construction selects non-cessation: the calamity does not move away from the deniers and does not stop arriving until the promised endpoint.

topics.headline: ongoing removal withheld
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consequence is not episodic only; it continues toward a divine appointment.
topics.reason: Rows support the auxiliary construction, root removal field, and boundary role leading into the punishment clause.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing those who denied as the subject of the ongoing clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) introduces the group that remains under ongoing consequence. The wording identifies them by the following denial-action, tying the calamity clause to a moral posture rather than to anonymous people.

topics.headline: deniers introduced as a group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ongoing calamity is attached to those characterized by denial.
topics.reason: The row evidence marks this relative pronoun as the subject phrase for the following denial verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb naming those who denied or covered over
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denying, ingratitude, and concealment; locally narrowed to the deniers whose deeds bring consequence
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) names the group by denial as a settled identity before the ongoing calamity unfolds. The covering-root image can suggest concealment and ingratitude, with the agricultural covering-seed sense remaining a secondary tension, but locally it identifies the people whose own making becomes the cause of recurring calamity.

topics.headline: denial as covered response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment clause is morally anchored in denial, not random misfortune.
topics.reason: Rows support the denial/covering root range, perfect verb form, and the link to the later causal phrase about what they made.

words.gloss_range: imperfect verb with object pronoun: a feminine subject strikes or reaches them
words.root_gloss_range: hitting, reaching, befalling, falling like rain, and correctness/aim; locally narrowed to calamity reaching the deniers as fitting recompense
words.prose: {{ar:تُصِيبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tuṣībuhum}}) makes the calamity actively reach the deniers as its object before the delayed subject is named, creating suspense around what strikes. The ṣ-w-b range includes hitting the mark, falling like rain, and correctness; locally the feminine verb points ahead to the feminine calamity noun, making the disaster feel targeted and fitting rather than random.

topics.headline: calamity reaches them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the calamity as something that reaches its target, not as vague background trouble.
topics.reason: Rows support imperfect-object grammar, delayed feminine subject, root befalling/striking range, and boundary role in the consequence clause.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition introducing the reason for the calamity
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) introduces the cause of the calamity’s reaching them. The consequence is measured by what they have made, not framed as arbitrary violence.

topics.headline: causal link to deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disaster is linked to their own action.
topics.reason: Rows identify this preposition as causal and as a bridge from denial to made deeds.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing the deed-content that caused the calamity
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gathers the cause under a relative expression: what they made. The wording leaves the deeds as a total moral product before the verb specifies making.

topics.headline: what they made
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cause as a whole field of produced conduct, not a single named incident.
topics.reason: Rows support the relative pronoun function before the making verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural verb of making or crafting in the causal phrase
words.root_gloss_range: making, crafting, manufacturing, and deliberate production; locally narrowed to the deniers’ produced deeds causing consequence
words.prose: {{ar:صَنَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:ṣanaʿū}}) gives the causal phrase its verb: the deniers have made or crafted what now brings calamity. The root's crafted-production pressure makes the consequence self-involved, and the open object after the relative phrase universalizes their manufactured wrong rather than naming one act. The root can describe divine artistry elsewhere (27:88), which sharpens the irony of their own fashioned culpability without changing the local sense.

topics.headline: crafted deeds become cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the calamity is tied to their manufactured moral product.
topics.reason: Rows support perfect plural grammar, ṣ-n-ʿ making/crafting semantics, and the causal relation to the striking calamity.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative calamity noun serving as delayed subject of the reaching verb
words.root_gloss_range: knocking, striking, pounding, and sudden calamity; locally narrowed to an indefinite striking disaster that befalls them
words.prose: {{ar:قَارِعَةٌ}} ({{tr:qāriʿatun}}) is the delayed feminine subject that explains what reaches them: a striking calamity. The q-r-ʿ image keeps a knocking or pounding force, while indefiniteness lets the threat remain repeatable and unspecific; the same root can evoke the named calamity scene elsewhere (101:1).

topics.headline: striking calamity as delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consequence is a striking event that can recur, not a fully specified single disaster.
topics.reason: Rows support delayed-subject grammar, indefinite form, striking/root semantics, and the calamity echo, narrowed to the local punishment noun.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive particle introducing an alternative to direct calamity striking them
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) opens the alternative consequence: either calamity strikes them, or it alights near their dwelling. The particle keeps the threat in two modes rather than collapsing them into one image.

topics.headline: alternative mode of consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consequence can hit directly or settle nearby as pressure.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as disjunctive between the reaching calamity and alighting-near clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect feminine verb of alighting, settling, or befalling, with debated subject assignment
words.root_gloss_range: alighting, settling, loosening, resolving, and becoming lawful; locally narrowed to a calamity or event settling near them
words.prose: {{ar:تَحُلُّ}} ({{tr:taḥullu}}) depicts the alternative as something that alights or settles near the deniers' dwelling. The root's settling and arrival pressure survives, while subject assignment remains cautious: the base feminine form naturally continues the calamity image, and the masculine variant can shift the subject toward punishment, command, or even the approach of the Prophet, Islam, or the Qur'an as an apparatus-level contrast rather than the governing local parse.

topics.headline: alighting near their dwelling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the threat shifting from direct impact to an ominous arrival near home.
topics.reason: Rows support the imperfect feminine verb, root settling/alighting semantics, and the debated subject relation to the calamity or an implied agent.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adverb marking nearness in place or time
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, kinship, approach, and offering; locally narrowed to spatial or temporal proximity of the alighting threat
words.prose: {{ar:قَرِيبًۭا}} ({{tr:qarīban}}) places the alighting close in space or time, making the calamity both proximate and imminent. The root's wider nearness field includes kinship and offering resonances, so the threat feels intimate and pressing, but local adverbial grammar selects proximity as the circumstance between alighting and dwelling.

topics.headline: near as spatial and impending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat is not remote; it presses near the deniers’ own sphere.
topics.reason: Rows support accusative adverbial grammar, spatial/temporal nearness, and the structural hinge between alighting and dwelling.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the reference point from which nearness is measured
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) sets the reference point for nearness: the threat is measured from their dwelling. This moves the consequence from abstract denial into lived space.

topics.headline: dwelling as reference point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that proximity is calculated from their own home-domain, not from a distant battlefield.
topics.reason: Rows identify the preposition as marking the spatial reference point for the nearby threat.

words.gloss_range: singular dwelling noun with plural possessive suffix, with variant evidence distributing the threat
words.root_gloss_range: dwelling, turning, circling, and cycle; locally narrowed to their collective home-domain, with circularity as secondary resonance
words.prose: {{ar:دَارِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dārihim}}) is singular with a plural possessive suffix, treating their dwelling as one collective sphere. The d-w-r field can suggest dwelling and circling, so the threat feels like a turn closing around home; variant evidence that pluralizes the dwelling distributes the same pressure across homes, and the same-surah abode echo points back to negative home-outcome language (13:25).

topics.headline: collective dwelling under threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment approaches their shared home-domain, not merely an external arena.
topics.reason: Rows support singular collective grammar, possessive suffix, dwelling/cycle root pressure, plural variant contrast, and same-surah abode echoes.

words.gloss_range: temporal endpoint particle governing the following subjunctive
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) turns the recurring calamity into a bounded sequence. The ongoing pressure continues only up to the coming of God’s promise, so the endpoint is divine appointment rather than human control.

topics.headline: endpoint of continuing calamity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recurring calamity is not aimless; it runs toward an appointed terminus.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as endpoint marker governing the following subjunctive and structuring the closure.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect of coming after the endpoint particle, with subject announced after the verb
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and event-arrival; locally narrowed to the arrival of God’s promise
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِىَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}) supplies the endpoint event: the promise comes. The subjunctive after the endpoint particle makes the arrival anticipated but not yet realized, certain in force while open in timing. The verb appears before its subject, so arrival is heard before the promise is named; the root's coming/bringing range makes the promise an approaching reality, and the same-surah arrival-of-signs contrast keeps authority with God (13:38).

topics.headline: promise comes as event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the promise as an arriving event, not just a stated idea.
topics.reason: Rows support subjunctive grammar after the endpoint particle, verb-before-subject order, ʾ-t-y arrival semantics, and same-surah arrival echoes.

words.gloss_range: verbal noun promise in construct with the divine name
words.root_gloss_range: promise and threat; locally narrowed to God’s promise as ominous fulfillment for deniers and assurance for believers
words.prose: {{ar:وَعْدُ}} ({{tr:waʿdu}}) is the subject that arrives: God’s promise. The construct phrase binds it to divine authority, while the w-ʿ-d field can carry promise and threat; in this context it is consoling assurance for believers and ominous fulfillment for deniers, anticipating the final appointment-word.

topics.headline: God’s promise as scheduled endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is not random disaster but God’s promised fulfillment.
topics.reason: Rows support iḍāfa grammar, verbal-noun force, promise/threat semantic range, denier/non-breach collocations, and the echo to the final appointment noun.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name as possessor or source in the promise construct
words.root_gloss_range: divine name and deity-reference; locally the source and authority of the promise
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) makes the promise explicitly God’s. The construct relation prevents the endpoint from sounding like anonymous fate and invokes the stable Quranic pairing of God with promise-fulfillment.

topics.headline: promise sourced in God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised endpoint carries divine authority.
topics.reason: Rows support genitive construct grammar and the Allah/promise collocation.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the closing assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) launches the final guarantee. After the counterfactual signs and ongoing calamity, the particle shifts the line into emphatic assertion: the appointment will not be failed.

topics.headline: emphatic final guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ending as a formal guarantee, not an afterthought.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as emphatic and structurally tied to the final theological landing.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name as the subject of the emphatic clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine name and deity-reference; locally the subject of the final guarantee
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) stands as the subject of the emphatic closing clause. The guarantee is grounded in God’s identity and agency, not in the promise as an autonomous mechanism.

topics.headline: God centered in the guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final certainty rests on God personally.
topics.reason: Rows support accusative subject grammar after the emphatic particle and the divine-name focus of the final assertion.

words.gloss_range: negation particle denying the following verb categorically
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the final guarantee its categorical negation. Before the verb names the kind of failure denied, the wording already excludes divine breach of the appointment.

topics.headline: categorical non-breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that promise-failure is ruled out categorically.
topics.reason: Rows support the particle as negating the following verb in the final generalizing clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect transitive verb denying breach or causing failure of the appointment
words.root_gloss_range: behindness, succession, difference, and breach; locally narrowed to transitive non-failure of the appointed time/place
words.prose: {{ar:يُخْلِفُ}} ({{tr:yukhlifu}}) is Form IV and transitive here: God does not cause the appointment to fall behind, diverge, be replaced, or fail. The imperfect presents non-breach as God's ongoing practice, and the kh-l-f root's behindness, succession, and breach range enriches the negation, while the same-surah no-repelling decree echo reinforces that divine decree cannot be displaced (13:11).

topics.headline: God does not cause the appointment to fail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final claim denies lateness, displacement, and breach around the appointment.
topics.reason: Rows support imperfect grammar, transitive object relation, Form IV force, kh-l-f semantic range, and the same-surah echo with 13:11.

words.gloss_range: definite object naming the appointed time or place that God does not fail
words.root_gloss_range: promise, appointment, appointed time, appointed place, and rendezvous-like mutual appointment; locally narrowed to the scheduled fulfillment that closes the ayah
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمِيعَادَ}} ({{tr:al-mīʿāda}}) is the object of the final negated verb and the ayah's landing word. As a mīm noun it can hold appointed time and place, turning the earlier promise into a concrete appointment, even a rendezvous-like meeting known to the parties. The waʿd to mīʿād root echo seals the movement from promised content to scheduled fulfillment.

topics.headline: appointment as landing word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse ends not on a vague future but on a fixed appointment that cannot be failed.
topics.reason: Rows support object grammar, mīm-noun time/place force, mutual appointment pressure, and the root echo from word 51 to the final word.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three passive clauses join recitation to mountains, earth, and the dead before the pivot to God's command.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence tests one recited discourse across three resistant registers: consolidated height is put in motion, continuous ground is separated, and extinguished life is reconnected by intelligible address. The passives withhold agency until the command-pivot gathers it under God.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply the common operative medium across all three transformations.
Going and flowing give the first transformation its vector of released motion.
A raised solid aggregation supplies the resistant mass that motion overcomes.
Severance and separation turn the second transformation into loss of terrestrial continuity.
The lower expanse opposite heaven supplies the continuous plane being divided.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers makes restored relation, not bare animation, the third test.
Loss of force and life names the maximal resistance to communicative reconnection.
Authority and sovereignty receive the agency withheld by the preceding passive constructions.

changed_reading.before: Three unrelated impossible miracles illustrate maximal scriptural power.
changed_reading.after: One recited medium is imagined reconfiguring material fixity, spatial continuity, and communicative death, while its realization remains under sovereign command.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command-pivot is followed by believers, severed hope, divine willing, gentle guidance, and all people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus moves from total physical compulsion to a question about cutting off expectation. Because God could guide everyone, believers are pressed to release the hope that spectacular textual force must compel a uniform human response; guidance remains a directed relation under will.

activation_trace.role: The whole affair or state relocates efficacy from the imagined instrument to God's disposal.
Completion without remainder sharpens both total command and the counterfactual of all people.
The cutting off of hope supplies the demanded change in believer expectation.
Secure trust makes the addressees' release of coercive expectation a posture of confidence rather than defeat.
Will attached to an object makes universal guidance possible but explicitly counterfactual.
Gentle indication toward a path contrasts guidance with forced material displacement.
Human appearance over against wildness keeps the counterfactual concerned with responsive persons, not inert objects.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks why believers have not despaired in general.
changed_reading.after: It may ask them specifically to relinquish the expectation that even maximal signs should mechanically produce universal guidance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Speech to the dead is followed by a recurring striking event caused by what deniers make, either hitting them or settling near their abode.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus inventories place intelligible utterance and a bodily wound under the speech root, while the striking event can be both collision and a rebuke that hits a hearer. This permits a consequence to function as material address: authored conduct returns as a knock at or near the household.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible utterance supplies the communicative pole of the mechanism.
A wounding mark joins speech to bodily impact without making the two identical.
One thing striking another gives the event its literal percussion.
A rebuke that strikes the listener supplies the event's possible admonitory function.
A calamity reaching a person links the percussion to an experienced consequence.
Making or doing supplies the conduct to which the material address responds.
Circular enclosure makes the abode a bounded field around which the warning can settle.

changed_reading.before: The striking event is a separate punitive appendix after the failed miracle hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: It can continue the communication motif as a material knock generated by conduct and delivered at the boundary of lived space.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deniers remain under an alternation of direct impact and nearby settlement until God's promise comes, followed by denial of missed appointment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Persistence, direct hit or nearby arrival, and an appointed promise form a distributed temporal process. Repeated local events are provisional installments rather than the terminal fulfillment, and the closing non-failure clause secures the endpoint rather than promising immediacy.

activation_trace.role: Persistence of state in the continuative construction stretches the warning across time.
Reaching and hitting a target supplies the direct branch of the alternation.
Settling in a place supplies the indirect nearby branch of the alternation.
Temporal nearness as something approaches completion lets spatial proximity also foreshadow an endpoint.
Coming marks the terminal promise as an arrival, not merely a statement.
An appointment bounded by time or place organizes the preceding events toward a fixed horizon.
A promise failing at its appointment names exactly what the closing negation excludes.

changed_reading.before: One final calamity is simply delayed.
changed_reading.after: Direct and adjacent events recur as distributed preliminaries until a distinct appointed fulfillment whose delay is not failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier earth sequence first supplies fixed anchors, then adjacent parcels receiving one watering but yielding differentiated produce. This changes cut earth from only catastrophic rupture into bounded differentiation: a common input discloses distinct capacities without destroying adjacency.

activation_trace.role: Division into portions supplies the focus image that the context can recast as differentiation.
Firm anchoring establishes the stable terrestrial baseline against which movement is surprising.
A separated piece or tract makes cutting productive parceling rather than necessarily annihilation.
Neighbouring proximity preserves relation between the divided parcels.
Shared watering supplies the common input against which different reception becomes visible.
Increase and remainder mark unequal outputs from adjacent, commonly watered ground.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 moves from extended earth and fixed anchors to adjacent parcels, one watering, and differentiated yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable ground, adjacent pieces, common watering, and unequal yield; I infer that the focus cutting can expose receptive differences. The live alternative is literal catastrophic fissuring.

changed_reading.before: Cutting the earth means only spectacular destruction of the ground.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean articulation into neighbouring receptive zones through which one recitation yields non-uniform effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descending water runs through valleys according to their measure, carries raised foam away, and leaves benefit in the earth. The focus transformations can therefore be read as channel formation and sorting: recitation does not flatten terrain but moves through capacities, separating transient surface reaction from what remains.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining let recitation function as a common inflow that encounters diverse channels.
Crossing distance or water lets terrestrial cutting become passage-making rather than only rupture.
Delivery by descent supplies the vertical arrival of the common medium.
Water supplies the material carrier for the context's routing analogy.
Flood-flow supplies movement through terrain and the force that bears material onward.
A valley as the flood's course makes capacity spatial and channel-specific.
A measure reaching its limit constrains how much each channel carries.
Floating foam supplies the conspicuous but transient response sorted from enduring benefit.
Remaining with patient stability marks the beneficial residue of the process.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving substrate in which benefit remains.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats descent, flow, measured valleys, foam removal, and terrestrial remainder in one causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a capacity-routed flow that sorts foam from benefit; I map recitation onto the common inflow and the focus terrain changes onto channel formation. The alternative is that the water parable concerns truth and falsehood without directly revising 13:31.

changed_reading.before: Qur'anic efficacy would be proved by uniformly overpowering resistant matter.
changed_reading.after: Its efficacy can be capacity-sensitive routing and sorting, with terrain reconfigured into channels and durable benefit distinguished from dramatic foam.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demands for a visible sign are answered by warning and guidance, then by return, remembrance, heart-settling, and recitation of what was communicated. These steps strengthen the focus contrast between spectacular compulsion and a discourse whose positive effect appears as responsive reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Cutting off hope marks the release of sign-based expectations of compulsory response.
A manifest marker supplies the demanded evidentiary mode that the focus intensifies counterfactually.
Warning that awakens caution supplies a non-compulsive communicative function.
Gentle direction to a path pairs warning with locally mediated guidance.
The repeated visible-sign demand frames the immediate lead-in to the focus.
Habitual return supplies the recipient-side motion that guidance does not force.
Settled calm supplies the inward effect contrasted with displaced mountains.
The heart identifies the living receptive site of the discourse's movement.
Bringing something present after forgetfulness supplies the repeated practice that settles the heart.
Following in sequence makes recitation an enacted continuity rather than an isolated spectacle.
Knowledge conveyed in hidden fashion contrasts the discourse's quiet delivery with demanded spectacle.

structural_cues: 13:27-30 runs directly from repeated sign demand to return, heart-settling remembrance, and recitation among deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-demand, warning, return, remembrance, settled hearts, and recitation; I infer that this sequence names the noncoercive efficacy contrasted in 13:31. Alternatively, the sequence may only juxtapose separate pastoral themes.

changed_reading.before: Only a discourse producing public physical marvels would count as effective.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects coercion as the measure of efficacy and points toward warning, voluntary return, remembered presence, and settled hearts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The storm sequence joins flash, fear and hope, thunder, severe overhead sound, and a targeted strike amid dispute. It gives the focus striking event an audible and admonitory register, strengthening the reading of a calamity as percussion that addresses without becoming ordinary verbal speech.

activation_trace.role: A bodily mark keeps communication open to an impact register.
A rebuke striking a hearer supplies the interpretive bridge from percussion to warning.
Flashing and thundering as threat supplies the anticipatory visual signal.
Heavenly thunder supplies the audible field in which the strike is heard.
A severe explosive sound binds the overhead event to acoustic impact.
Targeted arrival makes the storm's sound culminate in a directed hit.

structural_cues: 13:12-13 moves from fear-and-hope flash to praising thunder and a strike during active disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sound-to-strike sequence amid dispute; I infer that it can model the focus event as admonitory percussion. The alternative is a narrower weather-and-punishment scene with no communicative extension.

changed_reading.before: The recurring calamity merely injures or destroys.
changed_reading.after: It may also operate as a nonverbal warning that hits the hearer materially, though not every disaster should be decoded as a sentence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true call is present, yet nonresponse is pictured as extended hands unable to make water reach the mouth. Physical presence, desire, and proximity do not complete reception. The focus speech-to-the-dead image therefore tests relation and response, not an automatic conversion produced by sheer delivery.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech supplies an offered connection whose completion remains in question.
Calling by speech supplies the address that can remain unanswered.
Truth stably matching reality prevents nonresponse from being blamed on an unreal call.
Returning speech and answering name the missing reciprocal act.
Extending the hand supplies effort and desire that still do not secure reception.
An outstretched palm in request embodies dependence without effective grasp.
Available water supplies the near but unreceived good.
Reaching the endpoint names the failed completion between offered good and recipient.
The open mouth supplies the bodily endpoint that proximity alone cannot reach.

structural_cues: 13:14 distinguishes a true call from response and stages failed transfer from water, through hand, to mouth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a valid call and a failed reception chain; I infer that it qualifies the focus fantasy of speech producing universal response. The alternative is that the analogy applies only to invocation of other powers.

changed_reading.before: If the discourse could address the dead, hearing or belief would necessarily follow.
changed_reading.after: Even maximal address does not erase the recipient-side act of response; delivery, nearness, and desire can coexist with failed reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant sequence contrasts preserving and connecting with unbinding, cutting what was commanded to be joined, and corrupting the earth, ending in a bad abode. Earth-cutting thus acquires a social and legal topology: severed obligations partition a shared world and deform the household outcome.

activation_trace.role: Estrangement and severing connection open a relational sense inside the focus's terrestrial cutting.
Unbinding a firmly made structure supplies the destructive inverse of covenant continuity.
A confirmed covenant supplies the binding structure that cutting damages.
Uninterrupted succession without cutting defines the positive social continuity.
Contextual severance makes the focus cutting visibly available as broken relation.
Joining one thing to another identifies what the contextual cutting interrupts.
Departure from sound proportion names the resulting deformation of the shared order.
The terrestrial expanse becomes the field in which relational rupture takes public form.
Residence and belonging localize the social consequences in the abode echoed by the focus.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 forms a connect-versus-cut sequence and explicitly links severance to corruption in the earth and the outcome of the abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded connection, covenant unbinding, cutting, earth-corruption, and abode; I infer a social topography within the focus earth image. The alternative remains a wholly geophysical miracle image.

changed_reading.before: The earth is cut only as inert matter in an impossible sign.
changed_reading.after: Earth can also be cut through severed obligations that partition common life, making the later nearness to the abode socially consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: Change in a people is paired with change in themselves, while later scenes place every self under what it earns. These cues tighten the focus link between what deniers make and what reaches them: the recurring event reads as accountable feedback on authored patterns, without removing divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing supplies the authored conduct explicitly tied to the strike.
A calamity reaching a person supplies the returning consequence.
Changing a form or replacing a state supplies the two-sided transformation sequence.
The very self locates one side of change within the acting subjects.
Each self as the thing itself individualizes the field of oversight.
Acquiring through effort supplies the accountable output attached to each self.
Repeated earned acquisition confirms the conduct-to-account pattern near the surah's close.
The repeated individual self keeps the feedback accountable rather than merely collective weather.

structural_cues: 13:11 pairs outer and inner change; 13:33 and 13:42 repeat each self together with what it earns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal change, earned action, oversight, and the focus's because-of-what-they-made relation; I infer a feedback arrow from patterned action to experienced event. A live alternative is juridical accounting without worldly causal feedback.

changed_reading.before: The strike is an externally imposed event only loosely associated with prior conduct.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as divinely governed feedback in which manufactured patterns return to accountable selves and communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sign can arrive only by permission; every term has an established record; erasure and stabilization remain under God; the messenger may witness only part of what is promised, while delivery and account are divided; then earth is diminished from its edges. The focus promise becomes an authorized schedule that may unfold partially and edgewise before its terminal appointment.

activation_trace.role: A time becoming due or delayed gives the imagined recitation a latent temporal register.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place supplies the controlling horizon.
Coming marks the sign as an event whose arrival is governed.
A visible marker identifies the class of event whose timing is restricted.
Permission licenses the event and blocks autonomous sign production.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the schedule's bounded duration.
A recorded determination that entails judgment makes each term authoritative rather than accidental.
Removal of an effect supplies one pole of schedule revision.
Enduring fixation supplies the other pole of what remains established.
A spoken promise opening expectation permits partial witness without exhausting the promised whole.
Delivering the message delimits the messenger's task from event realization.
Counting and account reserve the terminal reckoning beyond delivery.
Coming to the earth turns fulfillment into an advancing process.
The terrestrial expanse supplies the same material field as the focus cutting.
Loss of part supplies incremental rather than all-at-once transformation.
The limit or edge localizes where the gradual terrestrial change appears.
Restraining and returning for correction makes the edgewise process subject to decisive governance.

structural_cues: 13:38-41 orders permission, fixed term, erasure or stabilization, partial witness, delivery versus account, and earth diminished at its edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorization, term, record, revision, partial witness, and edge-loss; I infer that the focus's recurring events are staged advances toward the appointment. Alternatives include separate prophetic-history and territorial referents with no single process model.

changed_reading.before: The promised transformation is an all-at-once marvel whose delay risks looking like failure.
changed_reading.after: It can unfold by authorized installments, partial witness, and edgewise terrestrial change while remaining ordered to a non-failed appointment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's non-dominant mapping for the guidance root carries demolition and loud sound, not the ordinary form's direct sense. It remains anchored by the exact focus root and by the preceding mountain, earth, speech, and striking images; downstream prose should present it only as a contrastive acoustic-force shadow, never as a replacement translation of guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The universal-guidance counterfactual follows imagined demolition-scale signs and precedes repeated striking events.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies the ordinary guidance pole that the outlier must not displace.
Severe breaking and demolition echo the focus's imagined movement and cutting as a coercive shadow.
A loud reverberating sound echoes speech and the later knock, sharpening the force-versus-guidance contrast.

changed_reading.before: Universal guidance is simply a larger quantity of the same gentle direction.
changed_reading.after: The split inventory lets the counterfactual carry a contained shadow of demolition and overwhelming sound, clarifying what coerced guidance would resemble and why the verse refuses to equate it with recitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because womb-carriage and a due or delayed time are peripheral images of the recitation root. It remains anchored in the focus noun, the gathered totality, and the closing appointed promise; downstream prose should call it a temporal-gestational activation rather than lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening recitation hypothetical is held unresolved until the closing arrival of a promise that cannot miss its appointment.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering and carrying a pregnancy supplies latent transformation held before emergence.
A time becoming due or delayed supplies maturation toward an appointed disclosure.
Joining dispersed parts into a collected whole supports the image of carried potential.
The bounded appointment supplies the eventual emergence point of the carried process.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical asks only whether recitation could trigger an immediate spectacle.
changed_reading.after: It can also activate an image of discourse carrying gathered transformations toward a due time, so non-immediacy becomes maturation rather than impotence.

strongest_changes: Earth-cutting changed from pure catastrophe into both adjacent differentiation and capacity-forming channels.
The sign demand changed into a contrast between coercive spectacle and responsive return, remembrance, and settled hearts.
The recurring strike changed from an isolated punishment into material warning and accountable feedback.
The unfailing promise changed from delayed single impact into an authorized, partial, edgewise schedule.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's impossible triad did not settle into one miracle claim: the packet activated material, hydrological, auditory, social, inward, and temporal mechanisms that remain anchored to the same focus constructions and can coexist without harmonization.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax and pragmatic force of the believers' severed hope remain open, so the anti-coercion reading is medium rather than decisive.
The terrain, water, storm, covenant, and edge sequences may be analogical activators rather than intended direct glosses of the focus.
The non-dominant guidance mapping and temporal-gestational recitation branches are deliberately retained as contained form-distant outliers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. Shared `ق ر ء/B001` has variants for gathering and gathering speech into recitation. Three transformations are gathered, then `جَمِيعًا` twice relocates totality to God. I infer that recitation integratively assembles signs and hearers under divine affair rather than acting as an autonomous instrument.
2. `ق ط ع/B001` is severing earth. Earlier productive pieces (13:4) and condemned cutting (13:25) show that cutting is neutral until related to function. I infer that the hypothetical tests raw power, while the surah asks whether cuts channel, differentiate, or corrupt.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:39's erasure and establishment later reinforced that transformation is governed operation, not autonomous textual magic.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The demanded recitation is made to perform disaggregation and coercion.** `ق ر ء / B001` is collecting speech into recitation, while `س ي ر / B005` is removing or driving away, `ق ط ع / B001` is severing, and `ك ل م / B001` is meaningful speech exchanged with an interlocutor. The counterfactual sequence asks gathered discourse to drive solid mountains, cut the earth, or make the dead interlocutors, then redirects all command to God. This follows 13:30's modest relay mechanism and precedes 13:32's history of mocked messengers. I assign recitation the role of gathering meaning and the three passives the role of demanded physical compulsion. The packet supplies the juxtaposition; I infer sign-demand shifts discourse from guidance into coercive control. The ayah reads as a category diagnosis: ownership of the command cannot be transferred to the messenger's recitation.

2. **Impacts are distributed in time until the appointment arrives.** `ص و ب / B004` is an affliction that hits, `ق ر ع / B001` is striking one thing against another, `ح ل ل / B004` is coming due or falling upon, and `و ع د / B003` is an appointed time or place. The latter half alternates direct strikes with events settling near dwellings, all under continuance until the promise comes. Nearby 13:26 has denied that present amplitude is final, 13:32 names respite before taking, and 13:34-35 contrast current and later outcomes. I assign the recurring impacts the role of partial previews and the appointment the role of terminal boundary. The packet supplies recurrence and endpoint; I infer distributed warning -> eventual completion. The promise's non-failure thus concerns timing and culmination, not constant immediate intensity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:32's explicit respite before taking explained how repeated impacts can coexist with an unfailing endpoint. 13:36's divided reception then corrected a power-centered reading: the unresolved problem is how gathered speech is received, not whether it can be imagined as physical force.

baseline.text: Dağların kendisiyle yürütüldüğü, yerin kendisiyle parçalandığı ya da ölülerin kendisiyle konuşturulduğu bir Kur'an olsaydı... Hayır, bütün iş Allah'ındır. İnananlar, Allah dileseydi bütün insanları doğru yola ileteceğinden hâlâ ümit kesmediler mi? İnkâr edenlerin başına, yaptıkları yüzünden sarsıcı bir felaket gelmeye devam edecek ya da bu felaket yurtlarının yakınına inecektir; sonunda Allah'ın vaadi gelecektir. Allah vaadinden dönmez.

findings.text: Gösterişli belirti talebi, anlamı bir araya getiren okumayı dağları sürükleyen, yeri parçalayan ve ölüleri konuşmaya zorlayan bir denetim aracına çevirmeye çalışır; oysa bu güç okumaya devredilmez.
Tekrarlanan felaketlerle aradaki süre, kesin vade gelmeden önce zamana dağıtılmış kısmi uyarılar oluşturur; gecikme vaadin bozulduğu anlamına gelmez.
Yeri parçalamak kendi başına iyi ya da kötü değildir; değeri, açılan parçanın yol mu oluşturduğuna yoksa bağlantıyı mı bozduğuna bağlıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Return, Guidance, and Entrusted Reliance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person turns toward a destination, follows guidance, and entrusts the journey's care to a dependable custodian.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Repentance becomes recurrent homeward movement, and trust becomes delegated care rather than passivity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Guided Route Under Trusted Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A guide indicates the road while a trusted guardian receives responsibility for the traveler's affair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gentle guidance to road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); delegation of an affair (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); reliance on another (`quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`); custodian sufficient to guard what is entrusted (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); lordship as care and mastery (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:27 `يَهْدِي` (ه د ي) and `رَبّه` (ر ب ب); 13:30 `رَبِّي` (ر ب ب) and `تَوَكَّلْتُ` (و ك ل); 13:31 `هَدَى` (ه د ي).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Guidance supplies direction; entrustment supplies dependable care. Reliance therefore completes rather than replaces the act of turning toward the destination.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Effective Utterance and Transformed Terrain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Recited communication is imagined as an operative force capable of moving, cutting, or awakening its object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Voice-following, inscription, movement, incision, and revived dialogue become distinct operations of effective speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Recitation and Transmission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Revealed information is carried by a messenger and voiced in a following sequence to hearers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); a second voice following the first (`quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`); divine message and inspiration (`quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`); messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); delivery of book or communication downward (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:30 `أَرْسَلْنَاك` (ر س ل), `لِتَتْلُو` (ت ل و), and `أَوْحَيْنَا` (و ح ي); 13:31 `قُرْآن` (ق ر ء); 13:27 `أُنْزِلَ` (ن ز ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Message, messenger, descent, leading voice, and following voice form a transmission chain. Recitation is the audible continuation of revelation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Effective Utterance and Transformed Terrain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Recited communication is imagined as an operative force capable of moving, cutting, or awakening its object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Voice-following, inscription, movement, incision, and revived dialogue become distinct operations of effective speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Moving, Cutting, and Addressing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech acts upon resistant terrain and silent bodies as if it were physical agency.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: compelled movement or travel (`quranic:root_000769:B001/m01`); solid raised mountain mass (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); severing or splitting (`quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`); intelligible speech linking speakers (`quranic:root_001316:B001/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); action or making (`quranic:root_000885:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:31 `سُيِّرَت` (س ي ر), `الجِبَال` (ج ب ل), `قُطِّعَت` (ق ط ع), `كُلِّمَ` (ك ل م), `المَوْتَى` (م و ت), and `صَنَعُوا` (ص ن ع).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Movement, incision, dialogue, death, and making remain separate operations, but all test what an utterance might cause. The scene pressures a merely informational reading of recitation by treating language as world-changing force.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal commitment becomes spatial approach and impact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Appointment and Fulfillment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A spoken promise creates expectation, fixes a time, and is met without failure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); appointment fixed by time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); failed promise as contrast (`quranic:root_000433:B005/m01`); arriving at and completing the appointment (`quranic:root_001669:B004/m01`); loss of expectation (`quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:20 `يُوفُون` (و ف ي); 13:31 `يَيْأَس` (ي ء س), `يُخْلِف` (خ ل ف), and `وَعْد`/`المِيعَاد` (و ع د).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Promise, appointed coordinate, arrival, and non-failure form a temporal contract. Despair is the collapsed expectation against which reliable fulfillment is defined.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A blow-like event reaches a traveled public place, a house yard, or a nearby station and settles there.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: impact of one thing against another (`quranic:root_001219:B001/m01`); road or house forecourt (`quranic:root_001219:B010/m01`); affliction that reaches a person (`quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`); settling in a place (`quranic:root_000351:B002/m01`); nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); encircling adversity (`quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:31 `قَارِعَة` (ق ر ع), `تُصِيبُهُم` (ص و ب), `تَحُلُّ` (ح ل ل), `قَرِيبًا` (ق ر ب), and `دَارِهِم` (د و ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Impact, forecourt, nearness, settlement, and encirclement make the promised event spatially concrete. It does not remain distant speech; it arrives at the threshold.
